title: Sab ka hussain
body:
Sab ka hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah
jaayen bashar ki nigaahein jahaan
maujud hai teri rehmat wahaan
hai teri rehmaaniyat se ayaan
mehdud hai teri rehmat kahaan
tere hi jaisa mohammad tera
jis ke liye shaayeron ne kaha
ishq hojaaye kisi se koyi chaara to nahin
sirf muslim ka mohammad pe ijaara to nahin
hai us mohammad ki aankhon ka chain
kehta hai jis ko zamaana hussain
insaaniyat pe huwa wo fida
har ek muslim to kehta hi tha
ab ghair muslim bhi kehne laga
<<MINI>>
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain
sab ka hussain
pyaare nabi ka nawaasa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam ka maqsood naame hussain
har dil me maujud naame hussain phir kyun ho mehdood naame hussain
hai hamd o mehmood naame hussain
<<MINI>>
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain
sab ka hussain
pyaare nabi ka nawaasa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan ka waada wafa yun kiya
kaaba bachaaya bhara ghar diya
jo kaam kar na sake ambiya phir kyun na tu hi bata ay khuda
saari duniya hussain hussain kare
<<MINI>>
aaqa hussain maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
rab ka hussain sab ka hussain
ehle sunnat wal jamaat ke buzurg shayer
peer naseer-ud-din shah farmaate hain
mera khuda jise auje kamaal deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
use batool ki chaukhat pe daal deta hai
parakhna ho jo kisi ko to ya hussain kaho
ye naam wo hai jo shajre khangaal deta hai
sunni ye kehte hain ya mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne hi ham ko aqeeda diya
tu ne hussain o minni jo kaha phir to ye kehna bhi sunnat huwa
<<MINI>>
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain
sab ka hussain
pyaare nabi ka nawaasa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hindu shayer jay singh ne imam hussain ki baargaah me yun nazraanaye aqeedat pesh kiya
hai aaj bhi zamaane me charcha hussain ka
chalta hai kaainaat me sikka hussain ka
bhaarat me gar wo aate bhagwaan kehte ham
<<DIVIDER>>
har hindu naam pooja me japta hussain ka
sar apna peet ti hain jo pyaason ki yaad me
leti hain naam ganga o jamna hussain ka
is me nahin kalaam ke ham but parast hain
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se apni chumenge roza hussain ka
ham paapiyon ke waaste hur ki misaal hai
chamkaata hai naseeb ishaara hussain ka
""jay singh"" panaah maangegi mujh se narag ki aag
<<DIVIDER>>
mein hindu hun magar hun mein sheda hussain ka
hindu aqeede ka ailaan hai
shabbir pe jaan qurbaan hai
pooja ke qaabil hai bhagwaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta ye saara hindustan hai
<<MINI>>
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain
sab ka hussain
pyaare nabi ka nawaasa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sikh mazhab ke naamwar shaayer
kanwar mahendar singh bedi kehte hain
<<MINI>>
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
lab peh jab shaahe shaheedaan tera naam aata hai
saamne saaqiye kausar liye jaam aata hai
mujh ko bhi apni ghulaami ka sharaf de dijiyo
khota sikka bhi to aaqa kabhi kaam aata hai
<<MINI>>
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu to har deen ke har dor ke insaan ka hai
kam kabhi bhi teri tauqeer na hone denge
ham salaamat hain zamaane me to inshaa allah
tujh ko ek qaum ki jaageer na hone denge
<<MINI>>
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho sikhon ke bhi afkaar me
kya hai ""mahendar"" ke ashaar me
bola aqeedat ke izhaar me
mein bhi hussaini hun sansaar me
<<MINI>>
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain
sab ka hussain
pyaare nabi ka nawaasa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek isaai shaayer ne mola hussain se
aqeedat ka izhaar khuch is andaaz se kiya
faqat hai pyaar ka daawa har ek mazhab ka
jahaan bhi zulm hai nafrat hai wo jehaalat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi wo dars hai jo de gaye yasoo maseeh
jahaan me khidmate insaaniyat ibaadat hai
hussain aap ne insaaniyat ka dars diya
hussain aap ne soda zameer ka na kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain aap ka paighaam bhi mohabbat hai
hussain aap ki duniya ko phir zaroorat hai
raahib jo tha ek isaai tha
aulaad na thi pareshaan tha
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne kiye saat bete ataa
khush hoke dunya se kehne laga
<<MINI>>
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain
sab ka hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaare nabi ka nawaasa hussain kyun saari duniya ki hai ye sada
batla rahi hai hame karbala
khanjar tale sheh ne sajda kiya
har zarra khaaliq se kehne laga
<<MINI>>

sab ka hussain

<<DIVIDER>>
insaan ka mohsin shahe karbala
insaan hi sheh ka qaatil bana
sab kalma go the sare nainawa
ehsaas kyun na kisi ko huwa

saydaaniyon ko kiya be rida
baazaar o darbaare ehle jafa
zainab ne har gaam khutba diya

ab to jo waajib hai ye kaam hai
""farhan"" o ""mazhar"" ka paighaam hai
